senses.gloss: m.(h. יָאֶה; v. אָוָה I, אוּת)fitting, right, nice.
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 11:11">Targ. I Chr. XI, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 23:8">Targ. II Sam. XXIII, 8</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Menachot 53a:14">Men. 53ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 166:1">Yalk. Ex. 166</cite> <he>י׳</he> it is good; <he>י׳ וי׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. to Men. l. c. note 40) so much the better.
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:53">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>בימא י׳ למידר וכ׳</he> is it better to dwell on the water or on land?—
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:67">Ib.</cite> <he>לא י׳ למלכא כזב</he> falsehood would not become a king.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 111a:11">B. Bath. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא י׳ וגולתיה יָאיָא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>וג׳ יאי</he>) he looks nobly and so does his cloak; a. e.—Pl. <he>יָאִין</he>, <cite ref="J00006"><he>יַאֲוָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00006"><he>יַאֲוָון</he></cite>, <he>יָאָן</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 3:7">Targ. Cant. III, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 4:1">Ib. IV, 1</cite> sq.
Targ. II Sam. XV, 3; a. fr.—Fem. יָאיָא, יָאיָה; יָאָה, יָאֲתָא.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 12:1">Targ. Y. II, Num. XII, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:17">Targ. Gen. XXIX, 17</cite> (ed. Berl. <he>יָאַיָה</he>; Y. II <cite ref="J00324"><he>יָיָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 6:2">Targ. Jer. VI, 2</cite> <cite ref="J00026"><he>יאתא</he></cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="J00015"><he>יָאִיתָא</he></cite>; h. text <he>נוה</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 13:19">Targ. Prov. XIII, 19</cite> (h. text <he>נהיה</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 111a:11">B. Bath. 111ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.—Pl. <he>יָאֲיָן</he>, <he>יָאיָין</he>, <cite ref="J00026"><he>יָאָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:17">Targ. O. Gen. XXIX, 17</cite> (ed. Berl. <he>יָאַיָן</he>).
